name: Akizuki Mizuho
source:
A gentle and demure Ojou-sama who exudes an adult charm.

Due to her magnanimity, she is admired just like a “Holy-mother” by the younger students.
Last year she was the president of the student council.

Despite her airily personality she is diligent at her core.

She is the leader of the group of students who work at the 'backstage,' doing all kinds of preparation for the events.
